envelope.description: Name the approval actor from body.approvedBy in backfillHead

body.title: Name the approval actor from body.approvedBy in backfillHead
body.summary: When an approved head has a non-empty string body.approvedBy, set lifecycle.approval.by to a person actor derived with the amendments module's personOf (namespaced id when the string looks namespaced, otherwise local:<slug> plus the original name); every other head keeps the fixed legacy actor. Add tests that an amendment reads back its approver's name and that a head without a string approvedBy gets the same lifecycle as before.
acceptanceChecks: An approved head with a string body.approvedBy gets approval.by named by it, with an id from personOf
A head without a string body.approvedBy gets exactly the lifecycle it got before
The amendment store reads the original approver name for the converted head

tests.name: convert-lifecycle-backfill.test.ts: an approved head with a string approvedBy gets an approval actor named by it
convert-lifecycle-backfill.test.ts: a head without a string approvedBy gets the same lifecycle as before
